descriptions.notStarted: They say that Cassandra will be giving out a Special Alphabet Letter on Back To School day! The Cassandra is only giving it out on that one day, so I'd better to get it now!

descriptions.completed: I received a Special Alphabet letter on Back To School day as part of MapleStory's Surprise Back To School event.
